'''International relations'''
*[[Nicaragua–Spain relations]]
**[[Spain]] expels [[Nicaragua]]'s [[List of ambassadors of Nicaragua|ambassador]] and another diplomat to [[Reciprocity (international relations)|reciprocate]] Nicaragua's removal of [[Ambassadors of Spain|Spain's ambassador]] and deputy amid longstanding [[International incident|bilateral tensions]] linked to Spain's criticism of [[Human rights in Nicaragua|its human rights situation]] and support for sanctions on the [[European Union]]. '''Law and crime'''

**[[National Police Corps (Spain)|Spanish police]] dismantle an international [[Maritime cocaine smuggling|maritime cocaine smuggling]] ring that uses [[Patrol boat|offshore vessels]] and [[high-speed craft]]s to deliver drugs to Europe, seizing 10 tonnes of [[cocaine]], confiscating dozens of vessels and vehicles, and arresting 105 suspects after a year-long multinational investigation.
